expected_unnoticed: the term is a constant offset OVER THE REALS and cannot change the argmin there: a pick is only ever left undefined by the `opts.length === 0` branch, so the set of unplaced indices is fixed by the pitches and the tuning before the search starts and is identical in every candidate scoreChord sees, and a candidate that fails on string collision never reaches scoreChord at all. THAT ARGUMENT DOES NOT SURVIVE THE FLOATING POINT, and the previous version of this declaration stopped there and concluded the output cannot change at all. It can. Scores are doubles, and adding 1000 rounds away the last bits that break an exact tie: ukulele, maxFret 12, chord [73,74,83] following [68,69,78] gives two candidates scoring exactly 53/5, which as doubles are 10.600000000000001 and 10.6, so without the term the second wins on `score < best.score`, and with it both round to 1010.6 and the first-enumerated one wins instead. Re-measured over 5,456 inputs across all eight tunings, 2,300 of which leave a note unplaced and so actually reach the term: 1 differs. The superseded measurement was 776 inputs and 0 differing, which was a limit of that corpus and not a property of the code. So this row is UNNOTICED because no test covers that voicing -- a coverage gap -- and NOT because the mutation is inert. The declaration also goes false the moment recurse() grows a real skip-this-pitch branch, which the comment at the foot of recurse() contemplates.

expected_unnoticed: nothing the suite renders reaches the branch: replacing it with a throw leaves all 79 tests green. That is what this row scores. THE BRANCH IS NOT UNREACHABLE, and the previous version of this declaration said it needed a caller outside this module. Timeline `units` are integral -- quantize() is Math.round, the gap and measure-remainder arithmetic is integer, chord length is Math.max(1, ...) -- and the glyph table bottoms out at q=1, so an integral remainder always places a 16th. But pushEvent slices events at bar lines using measureCapacity = divisionUnit * beatsPerMeasure / beatUnit, and the DECLARED OPTION TYPES let that be fractional: { divisionUnit: 4, beatUnit: 8, beatsPerMeasure: 3 } is capacity 1.5 and the 0.5 left at each bar line arrives here and is dropped. Measured with the branch replaced by a throw: it fires on capacities 1.5 and 0.5 and does not fire on 16, 12 or 3, so the probe can answer both ways. Do not restate the severity higher -- that combination asks for a 3/8 bar on a quarter-note grid, which cannot be written down whatever this branch does. The defect is that the remainder goes silently. So this row is a COVERAGE GAP, not an inert branch. NOTE the anchor was re-aimed by main d53bb31, which rewrote the comment the old anchor matched.
